prompts.reading: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent photographic cutout for SRSS school website hero. Edit target: the supplied photograph of one teacher in a navy-blue floral blouse and three primary-school girls in lavender and aubergine uniforms reading an open book. Remove ALL classroom/background including the existing navy haze, gray classroom wall and background blur, leaving genuine transparent alpha. Preserve the exact four people, their faces, identities, expressions, skin tones, hair, poses, hands, uniforms, the open book and the tabletop beneath the book. Do not redraw, beautify, change faces or add anyone. Retain natural soft hair edges without white or gray halos. Keep the group compact and all visible people and book in the same relative arrangement. Crop away the empty left background. Leave transparent space above heads and to the left. Gently fade only the lowest tabletop edge into transparency so it sits elegantly on a dark navy #06162F website background without a straight rectangular bottom edge. Faces, fingers, book and upper bodies must remain sharp and fully opaque. No text, logo, watermark, backdrop, shadow rectangle, checkerboard pixels or invented objects. Deliver a real transparent PNG cutout, landscape composition.
